components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant download or completion action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:44px; padding:0 22px; border-radius:6px; background:#4d9de8; color:#0d1117; font:500 15px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#63acf0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(77,157,232,.6); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action inside the graphite world.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:44px; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid #3a3e48; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#e8eaed; font:500 15px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1),border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#22252b; border-color:#838996; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(77,157,232,.6); }

components.name: Product Stage
components.description: The large cinematic frame for real Tortie footage.
components.css: .ds-product-stage { padding:32px; background:#101114; border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d34; } .ds-product-window { display:grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:16/9; border:1px solid #3a3e48; border-radius:10px; background:#1b1d22; color:#838996; font:400 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }

narrative.overview: Tortie is a quiet, precise window onto work that remains alive beyond the window. The site feels like a dark studio built around the product: matte graphite materials, hard-working hairlines, generous negative space, and one high-resolution view of Tortie in motion.
keyCharacteristics: Cool graphite fields with restrained tonal separation.
Large product imagery set into a cinematic, low-light stage.
Plain, compact copy with an obvious path to download.
One blue action accent; amber only for work needing attention.
Hairlines and alignment provide structure instead of ornamental cards.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means action or focus. It should remain rare enough that the download path is unmistakable.

rules.name: The Amber Means Human Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only when a person is needed or when evidence is explicitly limited.

rules.name: The Product Casts the Shadow Rule
rules.body: Marketing furniture stays flat. The app window may lift because it is the subject.

dos: Do make the product footage the largest visual object on the homepage.
Do use 1px hairlines and alignment to structure page chapters.
Do preserve native table semantics and contained overflow in Compare.
Do provide a real static fallback for every video or animated feature.
donts: Don't place a generic app screenshot in a floating rounded card beneath a generic centered hero.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, neon glows, or technical-looking grids as atmosphere.
Don't spend amber on decoration or routine actions.
Don't flatten evidence-backed comparison data into an aggregate score.
